For a quick bite ok .............. good view
May 2017 • Friends
Just having visited an office in IndoChina building a friend and I walked thru Mall to find the food court. Unique concept as you do not pay the food vendor rather you go to cashier and buy dong on a credit card. Then you return to what vendor or food you want. The average price was only 70,000 and variety good. They gave a number then staff delivered your food to table. It was filling, fairly good taste and nice view of river. Very clean tables, seats and floor. Air conditioned too......... a nice place to rest and talk.

The concept is great...
Nov 2015 • Friends
It's a big place with many different food center, that's great. You can find Vietnamese, Japanese and Korean food. A bit strange because of the name: IndoChina..no Indonesian or Chinese food ... but Italian food is not poblem.

We had Koerean and Vietnamese food. I wanted also Japanese, but they did not had the food I wanted. It was on the menu..and early in the evening, but no more available. In the next toko I wanted the chicken sup...also not available.
Lucky there was also a Mon Hue, I ordered crab sup...the sup was there, but the crab was not available. It had fiberglass noodles, very strange sup, For the menu card they did a lot of photoshop. I did not recognize it.
But the good point: they had cola light!!
The Korean food was good and the Vietnamese stew pot was also good...the vew outside was great. It's a nice place, when you come more often you will know wich food center is the best..
